summary: Phase 7.1 fourth dispatch: both residuals named by the 2026-07-28g banner are closed, one by discovering it was already proved elsewhere and the other by refuting it and replacing it. (B) TimeOrderConverse was NOT an open obligation -- Verified/Termination/Fuel.lean already proves it as orderDual_holds for every TimeOrdering, via open private reachableForward/reachableBackward plus the shared bfsClosure shape (bfsClosure_sound, PathN.reverse, bfsClosure_complete, BfsInv). OrderDual and TimeOrderConverse are the same statement; timeOrderConverse (Bridge/BoxSaturation.lean) is the rename, and every hConv hypothesis downstream is now dischargeable at the call site. (A) BoxTemporalSpread's TARGET was wrong. It is machine-refuted on the engine's own output: (box p and dia q) -> r at .Base, fuel 200, gives an OPEN saturated branch over 2 worlds and 7 times with boxTemporalSpreadCheck = false -- and the world there is minted at the SAME time the box sits at, so this is not the cross-time-mint case one would guess at. The cause is that boxDiamondPersistence relabels T(box phi) into every time the run later mints in that world, while the world-minting copy of allFuturePosAtTime happened once, at the triggering time. BoxAnchored replaces it: for each known world, ONE anchor time carrying T(phi), T(G phi) and T(H phi) together. boxAnchoredCheck and boxGridCheck are both true on every branch that refutes the spread; sat_box_grid_of_anchored derives the truth lemma's grid via knownTime_trichotomy about the anchor; boxAnchored_of_boxTemporalSpread records that nothing is lost. (Correction 8) The box invariant does not want a construction induction: timeOrderTotal, the grid's other side condition, is nowhere proved invariant under expansion either -- it is a decidable check on the finished branch, carried as a Bool hypothesis. boxAnchored_of_check gives BoxAnchored the same treatment and sat_box_grid_of_check is the composed form. All three O-obligations of 7.1 (O1 valuation, O2 gap policy, O3 box grid) are now discharged; the truth-lemma induction itself is the sole remaining item. 7.2 and 7.3 not started.

continuation_context.process_lesson: GREP THE VERIFIED TREE BEFORE BUDGETING A PROOF. Obligation B cost this dispatch nothing because orderDual_holds already existed in Verified/Termination/Fuel.lean under a different name. Obligation A cost a redirect because the invariant was adopted by reading Tableau.lean rather than by running the engine. Both failure modes are cheap to avoid: grep the tree for the statement, and machine-probe a candidate invariant on real engine output before proving anything about it.
do_not_reattempt: TimeOrderConverse as an open obligation -- already proved as orderDual_holds (Fuel.lean), for every TimeOrdering.
BoxTemporalSpread as a construction invariant OR as a saturated-branch fact -- machine-refuted on (box p and dia q) -> r; rows in Tests/BimodalTest/BoxSpreadProbe.lean. Use BoxAnchored.
A construction induction over expandOnceUnblocked for the box invariant as a PREREQUISITE for the truth lemma -- boxAnchoredCheck discharges it the way timeOrderTotal is already discharged.

BoxContextClosed as a construction invariant -- refuted on two independent counts (boxDiamondPersistence reads only boxPosAtWorldTime l.world l.time; boxNeg/diamondPos copy box formulas' contents, never the box formulas; witnessPresent tests the witness alone).
GapDemands as the gap obligation -- machine-proved vacuous (gapDemands_trivial), because Truth.future_iff makes its hypothesis its own conclusion. Use GapAdequate.
Folding the U/S straddling guards into the gap POLICY -- they are compound-formula obligations of the truth-lemma induction, not degrees of freedom of gapVal.
Defining the gap valuation by copying an adjacent placed point, in EITHER direction -- both machine-refuted (not_leftCopy_gapAdequate, not_rightCopy_gapAdequate).
Obtaining cross-world AND cross-time T(box phi) propagation from findUnexpanded = none -- measured impossible; boxPos emits T(phi), never T(box phi).
Adding the O3 lemmas to CountermodelExtraction.lean -- they live in Bridge/BoxSaturation.lean so an applyRule-unfolding timeout cannot take down the green prefix.
Omega := Set.univ (empty history falsifies every box); a universal TaskRel (nullity_identity is an iff); discharging forall tau in Omega, RegionConstant f tau, including via regionExtend.
